audio_description:
A trail rises off the planet.
The capsule coasts through space.

context.scene_title: The launch capsule travels through space toward the Lunar Base (Disc 3).
locations: Low orbit and open space above the planet

characters.name: (launch capsule, occupant sealed)

context.summary: Seen from orbit, a fiery launch trail rises off the cloud-wrapped planet, then the Esthar capsule coasts through the star-filled blackness of space, en route to the Lunar Base.
context.context_note: High confidence: the space-launch capsule traveling through space (Disc 3).
